_comment: Descriptors StageWright ships, so a pack that has one of these mods gets a handle on it having configured nothing. Each is gated on the CLASS, not the mod id: the class is exactly the condition under which its probe works, and every entry here was read out of the mod's own jar rather than remembered. A pack whose fork moved a class overrides any of these by name from config/stagewright/capabilities/. Deliberately short — this list is not an ecosystem census, and s.mods() already answers 'is X here'. An entry earns its place by naming a stable API root a scene would otherwise hardcode.
